question: An electric field of $10 \text{ V/m}$ is applied to an n-type semiconductor. The electron mobility is given as $0.25 \text{ m}^2/\text{Vs}$. Calculate the exact time taken by an average conduction electron to drift across a semiconductor crystal of thickness $1 \text{ cm}$.
